eligibility_notes: Startup age 1 year: inside the 2-year SISFS window and every 'early stage' window.
Founder age 41: no upper age limit on SISFS, MeitY, DST NIDHI, T-AIM, Hub71, YC or Techstars. Only youth-only schemes (some state 'young entrepreneur' awards, PM-YUVA 18–35) are out.
Hyderabad base: Telangana schemes (T-Hub, T-AIM Revv Up, T-Fund, TSIC) and IIIT-H / IIT-H incubators apply.
Gulf inclination: Hub71, Dubai AI Campus, Misk, Startup Qatar, LEAP India pavilion ranked high.
_meta.priority_rule: fit 5 = apply this month; 4 = apply this quarter; 3 = apply when the cash or market need appears; 2–1 = parked.

funds.name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
funds.amount: Up to ₹20 lakh validation grant; up to ₹50 lakh for commercialisation (via an approved incubator)
funds.who: DPIIT-recognised startup ≤ 2 years from incorporation, Pvt Ltd/LLP, ≤ ₹10 lakh prior government funding
funds.why_fit: Souveno is 1 year old and DPIIT-eligible: this is the single best fit for a cash grant; pilots with PSL Polymers / Manikan Cables are the 'validation' story.
funds.notes: Last cycle closed 31 May 2026; incubators (T-Hub, CIE IIIT-H, IITH) accept on rolling windows — the agent watches for the next window. | 11 Sep 2026: Souveno AI Solutions is a PROPRIETORSHIP (PAN BDNPP2011D). DPIIT Startup India recognition is open only to a Private Limited company, LLP or registered Partnership firm, so DPIIT (and everything that needs it: SISFS, 80-IAC, startup pods) is blocked until the business is incorporated as a Pvt Ltd / LLP. Udyam micro registration (UDYAM-TS-02-0251582) is in place, so MSME schemes (PMS, Telangana, IC) are open. | 13 Sep 2026: unchanged — DPIIT (Pvt Ltd/LLP) required.
